title: Schlieren gallery
description: A collection of experiments that make invisible flows visible: thermal plumes, liquid mixing, jets and electric arcs.

items.title: Candle plume
items.subject: Thermal flow
items.description: A candle flame and its rising plume seen through the rainbow schlieren setup. The colors reveal refractive-index gradients in the heated air.

items.title: Electric arc
items.subject: Transient flow
items.description: An electric arc between two electrodes, with a small disturbed region visible just above the gap.

items.title: Salt-water ring
items.subject: Liquid mixing
items.description: A salt-water structure entering the viewing region. Concentration differences make the evolving liquid interface visible.

items.title: Glycerine
items.subject: Liquid mixing
items.description: A curved glycerine interface and fine structures in the circular field of view, recorded during liquid-mixing experiments.

items.title: Water jet
items.subject: Jet flow
items.description: A jet emerging from a nozzle into the circular field of view, with a folded interface near its exit.
